note: Feature flags for HUD code that is written but not part of the base game. hiding: Orb removed hiding from the base game and holds it for a future stealth-specialist fighter (docs/ep/vision.md). With it off the HUD ignores the hidden state and the lost-trail cue everywhere (plate chips, the eye-slash marker, the strip's ping and last-seen mark, the silhouette's fading); the code stays for that fighter. Turn it on in a fighter's data when that fighter exists. touch_full and remap: the Settings screen lists the Full touch layout and the Remap controls entry, dimmed and marked Soon, until Controls' touch-full layout and the remap screen exist; both are on now. about_music and about_voice: the About page's two sentences that are true only once they are (the music was generated with Suno; there is no voice acting) are shown only while their flag is on; both are off until the music ships and Orb confirms the voice sentence (docs/legal/go-to-market.md section 1). A page item whose icon is named about_music or about_voice is that sentence. three_strengths: the martial face buttons are X light, Y medium, B heavy and the signature is the power button held with B (docs/design/brawl-second-pass.md, docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 48); flipped with Encounter's slice C2a, and with it the legend, the Full touch words, the Remap and How to play words, the weight mark's third value and the latched-charge and charges-off settings follow. damage_facts: no running count in the fight (EP decision on Orb's homework 5): the top chip is one steady line, the structures and craters lost, and it does not brighten when they change; the exact counts are on the match-over card (docs/ui/damage-chip.md); off, the chip dims at rest and brightens on a change and the card has no counts. People are never counted anywhere (RL-257, 2026-11-07). launch_marks: the marks that teach the launch without the three-strength button names (docs/ui/launch-teaching.md): the run of four pips on the rival, the plate's LAUNCH or RESTING chip with the rest's ring, OPEN, a full gauge that lights B with the word LAUNCH, the once-only hint and the pad's pulse at an opening; on since Game Design's ruling of 2026-10-16; the run's pips, the full gauge and the hint stay dark until the blow cue carries run and run_to. three_strengths turns these on too. reduce_flashing: the Reduce flashing setting row and the flashing notice's reworded line (VFX's register); on when Legal has approved the words. planet_map: the stand-in planet globe in the ring map's slot and its Settings row (docs/ui/planet-map.md). swing: the World turning row in Settings, for when the camera's swing lands. legend_clear (on): the control legend is not drawn over a fighter's body, and it comes and goes as a clean cut, never a fade (docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 73). answer_alert: the beam answer alert (docs/ui/beam-answer-alert.md): the screen edge line, the caption and the Beam alerts section of Settings, driven by the beam_window and beam_charge cues; alert_vfx, alert_audio and alert_rumble list the glint and air rows, the sound rows and the rumble rows only once VFX, Audio and Controls have their part (a setting never does nothing). brink_read (on for the private page): the brink reads in the HUD after its card fades: the plate's mark is steady (no pulse) with the words NEARLY BEATEN where there is room, the narrowest plates keep it on the pips' row, and the card repeats with A finishing move can end it when the rival's set-up opens him (docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 75). versus_flow (on): playing a second match on a pad: the match-over card opens whenever a human played and Back on it goes to Play again instead of closing it, it names the winner, the left stick steps the cards like the D-pad, Up from the top of the start menu reaches Start in one press, and Start pressed on a pad with Player 1 on the keyboard plays as the controller (docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 76). forms_live, specials_live, brace_live, vanish_live (all off): the hints for a press that does nothing in this build are not shown (Game Design, docs/design/pad-first-press.md): the TRANSFORM chip, the legend's and How to play's Transform, Specials and Brace lines, and the first How to play line's transform sentences; each is switched on by whoever makes that press real (docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 77). quiet_hints (on): the full-charge line stays up only while the heavy is held full (2.5 s at most) and shows the first two times, then not. legend_quiet (on): the legend and the prompt row are not drawn during a beam struggle, and after the opening seconds go quiet when nothing about the buttons has changed for 4 s; no row is listed for a press that does nothing (no not yet rows); the pad's face glyph is the diamond alone (the letter beside it, W or N, read as a key). chip_clear (on): the distance chip keeps one chip's height from a fighter however small he is drawn, and slides to the side away from his flight (no fade). legend_beam (on): the legend stays while a stance button is held and goes 0.5 s after it is let go; with Energy held the strike stick's row says Beam (hold to charge) and a second row Blast (flick), B reads Driver, and How to play has a Beam line; with Power held the stick has no row and nothing says Signature. split_fit (on): while Camera's record says the split has a share (70/30), the edge columns and the bark lanes are capped to the small pane and the plates ride their pane, changing sides in one cut (docs/ui/split-unequal-fit.md). beam_teach (on): Game Design's beam teaching (docs/design/power-scale.md section 5): with Energy held the legend says Hold right stick: beam. Let go to fire.; once on its own after 45 s with no beam fired; Hold for a beam after a flick with Energy (the first three times); Needs energy when the stick press is refused for it; RB + right stick: fire back for the computer's first beam, once. cross_end (on): 2v2's finished fight (docs/architecture/cross-end.md): the sim's `ko` event carries `over`; false for a first KO, which marks that fighter out (his plate stays knocked out), says You're out. Your partner fights on in the legend and a card for a person, and does NOT open the match-over card; only `over` true (the last KO, SimCore.ended) does. No `over` key reads as true, so 1v1 and older hosts are as before. refusal_words (on): a refused press or release says why in a short word at the edge (prompt.refuse_<code>: No energy, Hit, Too soon, Cooling, Too late, Tap to chase, Stunned), the first 3 times per reason per match, then only the pad knock; unknown reasons are silent and counted. struggle_teach (on): in a match's first three beam struggles the legend of each person in it shows what to press on the beat for that person's own mode (the option struggle_push, per player: Right stick, the default, a flick toward them; Face buttons, X, Y and B), with a ring on the glyphs at each beat and Off the beat for a stray press. The right-hand attacks have no flag here: they follow Controls' timing.json switches.rightStick.
